answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can earn, like a canyon crossing that charges a toll at the gate: one identity, one bond, slashed on fraud. Newcomers start with zero reputation and must complete small, checkable jobs to build it, a lotus that opens slowly, not on demand. Forging a thousand sybils then costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand work histories, while a single honest opal of a track record keeps paying. The defense is economic: sybils become unprofitable before they become numerous.
